title: MACP 2.0 Grant
description: One authority grant: permission for a holder to send steering/interrupt-priority envelopes to a subject (spec §9). Default-deny: without a matching grant, steering+ sends are parked for consent or downgraded. No agent can create a grant over another agent for itself.

holder.description: Address (or project id prefixed 'project:') whose sends this grant authorizes.

subject.description: Address, 'project:<id>' (all agents in a project), or 'link:<idA>:<idB>' (bidirectional project link, spec §9 G5) this grant covers.

max_priority.description: Highest priority the holder may send to the subject. 'interrupt' implies 'steering'.

granted_by.description: Who created it: a spawner's address (over its spawned agents only), 'config', or the human operator's address. Recorded for audit; MUST NOT equal a non-human holder acquiring authority over an unrelated subject (spec §9 G2).

expires_at.description: Optional expiry. Spawner grants SHOULD expire with the spawned agent's registration.

note.description: Human-readable reason, shown in consent prompts and audit views.
